serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table for bookedMin; service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its intermittent lag stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so the two are not expected to agree even when healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

excluded.reason: no dashboard site models this market

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity, not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero
